estimated_recovery_rate: All cryptocurrency lent under the Earner product was returned to users in full after discontinuation.
repayment_method: Return of cryptocurrency after the Earner product was discontinued
notes: The Federal Court penalty judgment records that all cryptocurrency lent through Earner was returned to users within weeks of discontinuation. This outcome applies only to Earner and not to Block Earner's separate Access product or current services. No exact universal completion date was identified.

repayment_method: Orderly voluntary product wind-down using user-initiated unlend and withdrawal through the Flint application
notes: Stage 2 review resolves the platform-wide outcome semantics as `not_applicable`, not `full_repayment`. Flint phased out its yield service voluntarily under regulatory uncertainty, published a first-party unlend-and-withdraw procedure, and told users that principal plus interest earned through 23 January 2023 was safe and would be returned. This was not presented as an insolvency, creditor-claims, or common recovery-distribution process, so a platform-wide recovery percentage is not the appropriate model. CYA does not claim that every user completed withdrawal, does not convert Flint's safety assurance into proof of universal completed repayment, and does not invent an exact final service cutoff where the historical sources conflict.
